diffs.diff: minimum supply: part 2 V, datasheet reading 3.3 V
diffs.evidence: The Pimoroni PIM449 silkscreen labels the supply pin '2-5V' (product photo RV3028_RTC_1_of_4.JPG). The PIM449 schematic wires that pin straight to RV-3028 VDD (chip marked '1.2-5.5V'), with only a reverse-polarity MOSFET on GND. The Micro Crystal RV-3028-C7 datasheet gives 'Supply voltage VDD, I2C-bus active: Min 1.2 V, Max 5.5 V' (1.1 V for timekeeping only). The second reading's 3.3 V comes from the shop page's marketing line '3.3V or 5V compatible', which names two typical host logic levels, not a minimum. 2 V is the board's labeled minimum.
